The Problem.

Traditional medical systems are often fragmented, leading to delayed appointments, mismanaged records, and a disconnect between patients and specialists. Prescripto was built to bridge this gap, providing a unified source of truth for medical history while streamlining the administrative overhead of clinic management.

The Solution.

We engineered a robust MERN-based platform that features a dynamic appointment engine, automated digital prescriptions, and secure P2P video consultations.
